claims.statement: Hierarchy normalization rejects the canonical root and control-plane identities on every source department, function, or instance node; graph and fully expanded semantic-tree views retain exactly 43 source instances and never create an orchestrator agent card or tree item.

limitations: The control-plane marker is static identity metadata, not a liveness, readiness, worker-health, or process-count indicator.

ORCH-01 owns frontend hierarchy identity and reserved-ID rejection. Exact source catalog and API inventory remain independently owned by CAT-01 and API-02; orchestration behavior remains owned by ORCH-02 through ORCH-09.

The browser gate uses Playwright-managed Chromium and loopback FastAPI/Vite services. It does not claim browser-engine, physical-device, operating-system screen-reader, or deployed reverse-proxy parity.
